description: Original pure isENOENT classification tests, including reconstructed SSH/IPC error objects. No real transport is exercised.
isolationRationale: Coordinator read both complete source files. Seven unchanged direct it() bodies call only isENOENT on in-memory Error instances or primitive values. The module imports node:path and realpath from node:fs/promises, but none of its filesystem/path operations is called by this entry test. No Electron, application state, sockets, processes, network, credentials or model calls are reached. This is source-inspected isolation, not a security sandbox.
dependencyClosureNote: The test imports vitest and one relative module. The module imports only Node builtins. NodeJS.ErrnoException is a type erased by the runner; this capsule does not establish a TypeScript typecheck or actual SSH/IPC transport behavior.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Both configurations use node. Use explicit original installed Vitest 4.1.11 and Node 24.19.0; actual receipt versions are authoritative.
The capsule omits renderer aliases, ORCA_FEATURE_WALL_ENABLED and the three DOM/host-port setup files; the fully read closure does not use them.

Root execArgv webstorage/GC flags, Windows worker limit and 30s test/60s hook timeouts are omitted. These synchronous in-memory assertions use no DOM, GC, webstorage, timers or platform-specific branch. This is not full source-environment equivalence.
